items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the separation axioms for a morphism of algebraic stacks and restates each of them through its diagonal and through the identity section of its relative inertia (author lemma at source lines 1796-1810, label lemma-definition-separated). The proof (source lines 1812-1849) identifies the second diagonal with the identity section of the relative inertia and verifies the listed equivalences with the characterizations established earlier in the chapter (proof lines 1812-1848). The correspondence between the axioms and the two diagonals is the substance. H3.
